historical_cutoff: Completion of final scheduled Week 6 game; 2026-10-19

rules.qualification: Market HR >= 6/10 OR at least one available DraftKings ladder has HR >= 8/10
rules.main_line_proxy: The CSV lacks a main/alternate flag and under prices. Main line provisionally inferred as the listed line whose over odds are numerically closest to -110; not explicitly source-designated.
rules.p16_p7: Interpolated 16th and 7th percentiles across up to 20 most recent qualifying completed regular-season games before cutoff
